title: Cargo Compartment Lining Panels — Installation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of cargo compartment lining panels with the panel-set rule that forbids mixing standards in one compartment, and the smoke detection functional check that closes the task.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of the lining panels in a cargo compartment, the rule on mixing panel standards and the checks that release the compartment for loading.
sections.job_setup_note: A compartment must be lined with one panel standard throughout: the recessed panels have no separate light clips and the clip-mounted panels have no light recess, so a mixed compartment leaves either an unsupported light strip or an unlit bay. Confirm the kit content against the compartment before the first panel is offered. The smoke detection functional check needs the compartment closed and the detectors uncovered.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE CARGO DOOR IS SAFE AGAINST INADVERTENT CLOSING BEFORE ANY PERSON WORKS IN THE COMPARTMENT. 2. Confirm that every panel for the compartment is of the same standard. 3. CAUTION: DO NOT MIX PANEL STANDARDS IN ONE COMPARTMENT. THE LIGHT STRIP CANNOT BE SUPPORTED IN A MIXED INSTALLATION. 4. Clean the frame brackets and confirm that no anchor nut is damaged. 5. On the recessed standard, fit the light assembly D2550118482429 into the panel recess before the panel is offered, and connect it as the panel is eased into position. 6. Offer the panel D2550118547929 and start every anchor nut fastener EN513769-76 by hand before any is tightened. 7. Tighten the fasteners in the sequence given in the task. 8. Confirm that the lens is flush with the panel face at every light position. 9. On the clip-mounted standard, install the light strip in its clips and connect it at the exposed connector. 10. Install the loading rail covers and the cargo nets. 11. Do the cargo compartment lighting check at every position. 12. Do the smoke detection functional check with the compartment closed.
sections.close_out: Make sure that no fastener is left loose and that the compartment floor is clear. Remove the protection from the smoke detector sampling points before the functional check. Record the installed panel standard, the lighting check and the smoke detection check result in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. A compartment must be lined with one panel standard throughout; a mixed compartment is a rejectable configuration.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the cargo door is safe against inadvertent closing.
Start every fastener by hand before any is tightened.
Remove the smoke detector protection before the functional check.
